findings.title: Authenticated route lacks authorization
findings.message: The authenticated account route has no recognized authorization marker.

findings.title: Upload filename reaches filesystem sink
findings.message: The request-controlled upload filename is used directly as a filesystem path.

findings.title: Destructive SQL is unscoped
findings.message: The function performs destructive SQL mutations without a WHERE predicate.

findings.title: Sensitive user fields are logged
findings.message: Credential-like user fields are emitted through logging calls.
